ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human raids, mechanoid raids, manhunter packs, and mech cluster defenders without hidden stat buffs. Homogeneous pure-role mechanoid swarms using vanilla edge-walk or edge-drop arrival can enter in two or three controlled waves from the original edge anchor as active combat power falls. Phasing starts only above a configurable count threshold; every planned wave must clear the higher of a fixed point floor and a percentage of the vanilla adjusted raid budget, with undersized tails intelligently merged. Reinforcements join the original raid Lord and share its current wait/attack state. Mixed forces use same-role vanilla promotion and may very rarely promote at most one boss only when that boss belongs to the current vanilla group maker's weighted pool. Breach, boss-led, center/random drop, grouped, and water-arrival raids stay outside generic wave handling. Deferred mechs and exact qualified wave plans are saved. The in-game audit page shows classification, per-wave points, minimum strength, wave state, before/after composition, and tactical proof.
通过原版高阶单位替换或安全的分批入场，减少后期人类、机械体、食人动物和机械集群同时存在的单位数，不添加隐藏属性 Buff。单一职责机械海只有超过可配置数量门槛才会分为两批或三批；每批必须达到“固定底线”和“原版调整后袭击预算比例”中的较高值，不足尾批会自动合并。增援会加入原袭击 Lord，与原部队共享当前等待/进攻状态。混编继续使用同职责原版高阶替换，并且只在当前原版编队生成器的加权候选池本来包含头目时，极低概率晋升最多一个头目。破墙、头目带队、中心/随机空投、分组及水中出现不会进入通用分批。待增援机械体和精确合格波次计划会写入存档，记录页面显示每批点数、最低强度和完整过程。
